decisions.reason: The accelerator is peripheral to the machinery core and earns little, so problemistic search makes it a candidate for discontinuation, but its low cost and its ecosystem-building role let a growing firm with slack keep it another year.

The bio-based bitumen binder remains a flagship of the strategic direction, and growth-driven slack lets management carry it while market results are uncertain, though its distance from the plant business keeps the risk of withdrawal moderate.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the core recycling machinery, is backed by the ERMAFA partnership and is presented as a flagship, so it is likely to stay while its results are judged against aspirations.
